faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NZP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NZP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Zoo Design Consultant, 1 Animal Health and Welfare Consultant, 1 IT and Media Consultant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NZP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 22 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1,00,000 per month for Zoo Design Consultant, Rs. 80,000 per month for Animal Health and Welfare Consultant, Rs. 60,000 per month for IT and Media Consultant.

faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E., M.E./M.Tech, Ph.D, Graduate, M.Sc, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Appointment on full time basis and not permitted to take up any other assignment. Absence from duty for a continuous period of 8 days without information leads to automatic termination.

faq.answer: Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through E-mail.

faq.answer: Initial tenure upto three years (1+1+1). Continuation beyond three years for upto additional two years on case to case basis.
